name: order_bug_ampersand_last
description: Escapes all five characters, but in the natural top-to-bottom order (<, >, ", ', &) instead of ampersand-first. This double-escapes the entities introduced by the earlier replacements (e.g. '<&>' becomes '&lt;&&gt;' instead of '<&>'). A realistic mistake: the agent adds the missing characters without noticing the docstring's explicit ampersand-first requirement.
